name: sproto-language
description: Sproto language support for VS Code: scoped type navigation, completion, diagnostics and configurable semantic colors.
author: Yexiao

commands.title: Sproto: 配置高亮颜色 / Configure Sproto Highlight Colors
Sproto: 打开设置 / Open Sproto Settings

sproto.colors.typeDeclaration.markdownDescription: 类型声明颜色 / Color. 留空继承编辑器原生配色 / Leave empty to inherit native colors; 输入十六进制颜色 / enter a hex color. 也可运行 **Sproto: 配置高亮颜色 / Configure Sproto Highlight Colors** 使用颜色选择器 / use the color picker.
